create_instructions_base: create an InstructionsBase environment instance with a config dict containing reward, color, and instruction file settings
run_on_reset: run on_reset to sample a random trajectory, load instructions, set up waypoint rewards, and position the agent at the start
get_reward: get_reward to check if the agent is at a waypoint or goal pano and return the corresponding reward
get_info: get_info to retrieve current step, goal id, distance to goal, and optional ground truth bearing to next pano
run_done: run done to check if the agent has reached the goal and the episode should terminate
